usereventscript.name: SUST - Settlement Status Change
usereventscript.description: v2: Auto-creates vendor bills on settlement status transitions. Bill lines use a non-inventory Settlement Fee item when configured (SETTLE-009), falls back to expense account otherwise.

scriptcustomfield.description: Internal ID of the non-inventory "Settlement Fee" item created per V2_SETUP §1. When set, vendor bills use this item line; when blank, falls back to legacy expense account 447.
scriptcustomfield.help: Optional. Internal ID of the non-inventory Settlement Fee item created in NS UI (see V2_SETUP.md §1). Recommended for cleaner accounting + better bill PDFs. Leave blank to use legacy expense-account fallback.
scriptcustomfield.label: Settlement Fee Item ID
